verdict.rationale: Mercury's Bill Pay AI reads bills, auto-populates details, remembers vendors, and supports approval routing (one-click accountant approval, permissioned payments), covering much of the coding/approval-routing part of the workflow. However, there is no evidence of purchase-order creation or automated PO-to-invoice matching anywhere in the docs or API catalog. Missing for 10: purchase order matching/reconciliation capability, evidence of multi-step approval workflows beyond single-click approval, and any mention of 3-way match logic.
